segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קלז
הַחֵלֶק אֱלֹהִי מִמַּעַל שֶׁיֵּשׁ לִי אוֹמֵר לִי וּמְלַמֵּד אוֹתִי לִשְׁמֹר כִּדְבָרֶיךָ:
segments.en: Through occupying oneself to speak with one's fellow in the fear of Heaven — through this one merits to attain the surrounding lights [oros ha-makifim]. That is — one merits to attain and understand what one could not attain and understand before. And likewise one merits to attain — each time according to one's level — increasingly higher surrounding lights.
